calculation.description: Compute five-day asset return using completed daily closes. Reverse the return cross-section; amplify reversal when five-day VIX change is positive, and damp it when VIX change is non-positive. VIX is observation-only and is never traded.
calculation.information_timing: At date t use closes through t and VIX through t; implementation decision must use the previous completed bar, with forward return beginning after signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year tested: 2020 0.056635, 2021 0.050356, 2022 0.118517, 2023 0.026484, 2024 0.082265, 2025 0.012267, 2026 0.042756. Small 15-instrument cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
